entries.rationale: Reviewed re-exports are part of normal Rust API organization.
entries.safety_invariant: Public surface and restricted internal visibility remain independently inventoried and ratcheted.
entries.alternatives_considered: Forcing wrapper definitions would obscure identity and duplicate documentation.
entries.substitute: unreachable_pub, API review, and restricted-visibility policy

entries.rationale: The question-mark operator is the preferred typed error-propagation mechanism.
entries.safety_invariant: Error context and public error contracts remain reviewed at the propagation boundary.
entries.alternatives_considered: Manual matches are longer and easier to get wrong.
entries.substitute: typed Result propagation and anyhow context checks

entries.rationale: This lint conflicts directly with the enabled unseparated_literal_suffix rule.
entries.safety_invariant: One canonical numeric-literal style remains enabled and enforced.
entries.alternatives_considered: Enabling contradictory style lints makes every spelling invalid.
entries.re_review_phase: Whenever the selected literal style changes

entries.rationale: This lint conflicts directly with the enabled semicolon_inside_block rule.
entries.safety_invariant: One canonical semicolon placement remains enabled and enforced.
entries.alternatives_considered: Enabling contradictory placement rules creates unavoidable warnings.
entries.re_review_phase: Whenever the selected semicolon style changes

entries.rationale: Short type-refinement shadowing keeps one conceptual value under one name.
entries.safety_invariant: Shadowing stays lexical and compiler ownership rules prevent use of the replaced binding.
entries.alternatives_considered: Artificial suffixes retain obsolete bindings and make transformations harder to read.
entries.substitute: small scopes, type checking, and shadow_same warnings

entries.rationale: Nested scopes may reuse conventional local names without implying shared lifetime or meaning.
entries.safety_invariant: The compiler resolves every binding lexically and same-scope shadow hazards remain separately linted.
entries.alternatives_considered: Globally unique local names add noise without preventing lexical mistakes.
